symbols.name: Coins (Penny, Quarter, Special Coins)
symbols.description: Coins appear repeatedly throughout the events with apparent symbolic meaning. Started at Harrahs with strange vending machine coins going to tip jar. The 'coins man' bartender comment. Left behind: penny with shield, quarter with 'Hope' on it, updown coin. Coins may represent small, traceable transactions or 'pieces' of larger operations.
symbols.interpretation: Small pieces of larger transactions, 'break into small pieces' advice, traceability demonstration
symbols.notes: One of the most consistent symbols across events

symbols.name: Blue Color / Blue Painted Fingertips
symbols.description: Blue appears as a significant color, most notably with the Starbucks 'Blue Painter' who had blue painted fingertips matching Expanse company color. Blue may signify unknown surveillance/tracking (can't see source of observation).
symbols.interpretation: Unknown observability, surveillance from unseen source, Expanse connection
symbols.notes: Matches narrator's company color - personalized reference

symbols.name: Green Color (Chips, Folders, Tape)
symbols.description: Green appears on poker chips, folders found on bed after casino visit, and tape on $20 bill. The green chip rolled toward narrator at Harrahs. Green chip tournament at Hollywood. May signify money, opportunity, or 'go' signal.
symbols.interpretation: Money/financial opportunity, go signal, invitation to participate
symbols.notes: Green = money makes sense in financial context

symbols.name: Yellow Color (Earbuds, Shirt)
symbols.description: Yellow appears on earbuds case of man at Harrahs table and on shirt of large observer at Crow Coffee. Yellow commonly means 'warning' - possibly wire warning or caution about speaking freely.
symbols.interpretation: Warning signal, possible wire warning, caution about surveillance

symbols.name: Name 'Matthew'
symbols.description: Narrator's first name appeared on dealer at Harrahs Day 2 - immediate recognition that this was personalized. Creates uncertainty whether events are coincidence or targeted.
symbols.interpretation: Demonstrating knowledge of narrator's identity, personalized experience
symbols.notes: Combined with 'Shane' dealer makes coincidence very unlikely

symbols.name: Name 'Shane'
symbols.description: Narrator's middle name appeared on second dealer at Harrahs Day 2. Combined with 'Matthew' dealer, demonstrated specific knowledge of narrator's full legal name.
symbols.notes: Matthew + Shane together is statistically very unlikely to be random

symbols.name: 911 References
symbols.description: The number 911 appears in various forms - the hotel room entry led to 911 call. May be coded reference to emergency, danger, or call for help.
symbols.interpretation: Emergency, danger signal, call for external help
symbols.notes: Less established pattern, needs more data points

symbols.name: Lysol
symbols.description: Lysol was on narrator's nightstand in apartment. Logan at Keystone randomly said 'Lysol' during conversation without context. This is the strongest evidence of apartment visual surveillance - there's no way Logan could know this without seeing inside the apartment. Additionally, Lysol could symbolize 'cleaning money' (money laundering).
symbols.interpretation: Proof of visual surveillance of apartment interior; could also mean 'cleaning money' (laundering)
symbols.notes: Most definitive surveillance evidence - highly specific, out-of-context reference. Dual meaning: surveillance confirmation + money laundering reference.

symbols.name: Chip Movements / Rotation
symbols.description: Poker chip movements appear to serve as nonverbal signals. Rotating chip twice then flipping seemed to correlate with opponents going all-in. The dealer 'turning it on' may reference activating this system for a player.
symbols.interpretation: Nonverbal betting/game control signals, VIP activation
symbols.notes: Needs validation with more tournaments, but correlation was strong

symbols.name: Speaker (Large Lobby Speaker)
symbols.description: Giant car speaker appeared in apartment lobby the morning after Crow Coffee event, positioned exactly where narrator had turned bag the night before. Speaker = request to speak/clarify verbally.
symbols.interpretation: Request for verbal communication, speak clearly, clarification needed
symbols.notes: Exact positioning match is strong evidence of intentionality

symbols.name: Earmuffs (Thrown Away)
symbols.description: At The Landing, girl found earmuffs and asked what to do with them, then threw them away. Interpretation: don't need to listen/speak directly, can communicate through data/observation.
symbols.interpretation: Can communicate without direct speech, observation is sufficient
symbols.notes: Interpretation is speculative but timing was notable

symbols.name: Diamond / 10 of Diamonds
symbols.description: Diamond Man at Harrahs Day 1 with large diamond rings. Dealer at Hollywood said 'you revealed a 10 of diamonds' when narrator hadn't. 10 of diamonds may be VIP/high status code.
symbols.interpretation: Upper Management status?, high value, diamond tier in system
symbols.notes: Diamond Man was clearly VIP-presenting, supports status interpretation
